children: Overview
UK digital media firm's H1 2026 revenue fell 7% yr/yr amid audience headwinds
Adjusted EBITDA swung to a small loss, reflecting lower audience volumes and investment in video
Company implemented cost reductions and expanded original video production to offset platform changes
Outlook
Company expects H2 2026 revenue to decline by a similar percentage as H2 2025
Digitalbox expects FY 2026 revenue and adjusted EBITDA below previous market expectations
Company targets adjusted EBITDA margin of about 8% for FY 2026
Result Drivers
META ALGORITHM CHANGES - Co said audience volumes fell sharply from Q2 as Meta shifted to favour video-led creator content
IMPROVED MONETISATION - Co said advertising performance, session values and yields improved significantly yr/yr
COST REDUCTION - Co implemented cost reduction measures to align operating base with lower audience levels
